# Combobox

Search a list and pick one value, or several (D130). Focus stays in the input; `aria-activedescendant` names the highlighted option. The popup is a manual popover on the top layer, placed under the control and at least as wide as it; it closes on an outside pointerdown, Esc, Tab and blur. The open state is internal: the list opens and closes with typing. Inside a Field, the id, label, description, invalid and required wiring are taken automatically, as Select takes them (D49).

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `multiple` | `boolean` | false | no | Pick several values, shown as Tags. |
| `value` | `string \| string[] \| null` | — | no | The picked option's value, controlled; null for none. The picked values, controlled. |
| `defaultValue` | `string \| string[] \| null` | — | no | The picked option's value, uncontrolled. The picked values, uncontrolled. |
| `onChange` | `((value: string \| null) => void) \| ((values: string[]) => void)` | — | no | Called with the picked value, or null when the text is emptied. Called with every picked value after each change. |
| `size` | `24 \| 32 \| 40 \| 48` | 32 32 | no | Height in px. Height in px; the control grows from it as Tags wrap. 24 is excluded: a 24px Tag doesn't fit inside a 24px control. |
| `options` | `ComboboxOption[]` | — | yes | The choices, as data: each option's label is what the filter reads. |
| `filter` | `false \| ComboboxFilter` | "contains", case- and accent-blind | no | The default (undefined) is a "contains" match on the label that ignores case and accents. A function replaces it. `false` hands the list to the caller: the options are shown as given, and nothing is filtered. |
| `inputValue` | `string` | — | no | The text in the input, controlled. Pair with onInputChange. |
| `onInputChange` | `((text: string) => void)` | — | no | Called with the text whenever it changes: typing, a pick, a revert on blur, a clear. A caller that reads options as the user types listens here. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | false | no | A read is in flight: a status line shows, and the listbox is aria-busy. Keep passing the last options; they stay on screen. |
| `moreMessage` | `ReactNode` | — | no | A line after the listbox, for a cut-off caller-owned list ("Showing 50 of 812. Keep typing to narrow it."). |
| `error` | `boolean` | false | no | Show error styling. Inside a Field, the Field's error also lights this. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | false | no |  |
| `placeholder` | `string` | — | no | Native placeholder text shown while the field is empty (only on components whose host element supports it). |
| `name` | `string` | — | no | Writes hidden inputs, one per value, so a native form submits the values rather than the text. |
| `required` | `boolean` | false | no | Sets the input's custom validity while the value is empty, so native validation and :invalid work. Inside a Field, the Field's required also sets this. |
| `clearable` | `boolean` | false | no | Adds a button that empties the value and the text. |
| `clearLabel` | `string` | "Clear" | no | The clear button's name. |
| `toggleLabel` | `string` | "Show options" | no | The chevron button's name. |
| `removeLabel` | `((label: string) => string)` | (label) => `Remove ${label}` | no | Each Tag's remove button, in multi-select. |
| `emptyMessage` | `ReactNode` | "No matches" | no | The status line when nothing matches. |
| `loadingMessage` | `ReactNode` | "Loading…" | no | The status line while loading. |
| `resultsLabel` | `((count: number) => string)` | "1 result" / "N results" | no | What the live region says after filtering. |
| `className` | `string` | — | no | Goes on the root element. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLInputElement>` | — | no | Forwarded ref to the `<input>`. |

## Keyboard & assistive tech

| Keys | Behavior |
|---|---|
| Typing | Opens the list and filters it; the first match is highlighted. |
| Arrow Down / Arrow Up | Closed: opens the list on the picked option, or else the first / last. Open: moves the highlight, wrapping at the ends. Disabled options are reachable. |
| Alt + Arrow Down / Alt + Arrow Up | Alt + Down opens the list without highlighting an option; Alt + Up closes it. |
| Page Down / Page Up | Open: moves the highlight 10 options, stopping at the ends. |
| Home / End | Move the caret in the text (native); they never move the highlight. |
| Enter | Open: picks the highlighted option and never submits the form; single-select closes the list, multi-select keeps it open; on a disabled option it does nothing. Closed: native (submits a form). |
| Escape | Open: closes the list and stops propagation, so a surrounding Dialog stays open. Closed: clears the text, if there is any. |
| Tab / Shift + Tab | Closes the list and moves focus on; picks nothing. |
| Backspace (multi-select, empty input) | Removes the last picked value. |

Follows the ARIA 1.2 combobox pattern with list autocomplete (D130). Focus stays in the <input role="combobox" aria-autocomplete="list" autocomplete="off">; aria-expanded and aria-controls name the listbox, and aria-activedescendant names the highlighted option while the list is open, which is also drawn with the highlighted background while the input keeps its focus ring. The popup is a manual popover on the top layer (it draws above a modal Dialog) holding a role="listbox" (aria-multiselectable in multi-select, aria-busy while loading) named by the Field's label or the input's aria-label; options are role="option" with aria-selected, aria-disabled where disabled, and a description joined into the name. The "No matches", loading and "more" lines are siblings of the listbox, never options. A polite, visually hidden live region says the result count after filtering (resultsLabel), the loading line or "No matches". When the options change, the highlight stays on the same option by value, else moves to the first, else clears. The chevron, the clear button and each Tag's remove button are tabindex=-1, so the Combobox is one Tab stop; pressing them, or an option, keeps focus in the input. Single-select picks only from the list: on blur, unmatched text goes back to the picked label, and emptied text clears the value to null. required sets aria-required and a custom validity read from the value, not the text. Inside a Field the id, label, description, invalid and required wiring are automatic (D49). Translatable names: clearLabel, toggleLabel, removeLabel, emptyMessage, loadingMessage, resultsLabel.

## Theming

Override `--psi-combobox-*` custom properties at any scope; interactive states derive automatically (L - 0.04 hover, L - 0.08 active).



## Rules

- One accent per visual group; everything else neutral or ghost.
- danger only for actions with real consequences.
- Sizes are px numbers (24|32|40|48), never S/M/L.
- Typography tokens are --psi-text-{size}-{lineHeight}-{weight}.
- Override component tokens (--psi-{component}-*), not semantic tokens, for one-off theming.
- --psi-button-font overrides button typography across all sizes (documented D34 override; ember → mono).
- Wrap labeled form controls in Field — label association, description/error line, aria-describedby and aria-invalid come wired; don't hand-roll label+message rows.
- Field is for a control with a *visible* label. A toolbar filter control named by aria-label or placeholder takes neither a Field nor a hand-rolled label row — compare filter-toolbar (no labels) with table-pagination ("Rows per page" visible, so Field). Filters with visible labels submitted together by a Find button are filter-form: a Toolbar as="form" align="start" of Fields with one-line labels, where a field's error line is the Field's own and hangs below its control (D87, D92).
- Label beside its control: <Field labelPosition="start"> for one field in a toolbar or pager (keep Toolbar align="center"); <FieldStack labelPosition="start"> for a form whose labels share one column, as wide as the longest label up to --psi-field-label-max-width, stacking below 480px of the form's width. A theme sets --psi-field-label-align: end to put labels against their controls (D115).
- Width of a control: <Field controlWidth={80|120|160|240|320|480}> sizes the control it wraps in px and lets it shrink in a narrower column; the label and message keep the Field's width. Pick the step from the value: at size 32 an Input fits about 7/12/17/26/36/55 digits (an ICCID's 20 digits → 240; a page-size Select → 80). Without it the control fills the Field. A FieldStack stops at --psi-field-stack-max-width (640px). In a Toolbar, the control of a top-labelled Field without controlWidth takes --psi-toolbar-control-width (200px), as a bare control does, so filter-form and date-range-filter rows are even; controlWidth replaces it, and a side-labelled Field (Rows per page) keeps its content width (D135).
- A popup's maximum height is --psi-popup-max-height (320px), shared by every popup through its own alias (--psi-menu-max-height, --psi-combobox-popup-max-height); past it the popup scrolls. Override the alias for one component, the shared token for all (D131).
- Select for a short fixed list; Combobox when the list is long enough to search, or more than one value is picked (D130). Combobox takes options as data ({value, label, description?, disabled?}), filters as the user types, and with multiple shows the picked values as Tags. Select has no multiple.
- Use Dialog for blocking modal flows — title/footer slots, dismissible gate; danger stays on the footer Buttons, one accent per group.
- Text links are Link (React) or the .psi-link class on any <a>: accent colour, underlined at rest, never by colour alone (D119). A router app passes its own link as Link's only child. Button href is for an action that should look like a button. Inside a NavItem or among NavBar's links, pass your router link itself, not Link.
- Pick between Tabs, SegmentedControl and RadioGroup by the job (D132). Switch 2–4 views of one region compactly (Map/Trace, Preview/Code): <Tabs> with a <SegmentedControl aria-label> (no value: Tabs owns it) of <Segment>s in place of TabList, outside the TabPanels, plus a TabPanel per segment. Switch page sections, more than 4 views, or a vertical list: Tabs + TabList + Tab. Pick one of 2–4 short options that applies at once (Light/Dark/System, a theme): <SegmentedControl aria-label value onValueChange>, a radio group wherever it sits (value makes it one). A value a form submits, options with descriptions, or more than 4: RadioGroup (Select for many). An action: Button or Toolbar. Segment labels are one or two words; the control never wraps, and truncates them when its container is narrower; fill shares the width equally. Sizes 24|32|40.
- A count after a label is Count (D124): neutral by default; tone="attention" is a pill and should carry a label ("4 stuck"), since the tone is visual. A Count is never a live region. In a NavTree, pass it as NavItem's count, and an icon as icon on NavItem or NavGroup; the icon is decorative and sized by the tree.
